concerns.text: SC-001 requires that ≥ 95 % of SOCs have finite ROR/PRR/IC values, but the validation script (T026) only logs the proportion (VALID_SOC_PROPORTION) without asserting or failing the pipeline when the threshold is not met, effectively weakening the success criterion.

SC-002 mandates monotonicity of Benjamini‑Hochberg adjusted p‑values; T026 checks monotonicity and logs PASSED/FAILED but does not enforce a failure if monotonicity is violated, thus dropping the acceptance condition.
